run_get_available_cpus_per_node: run get_available_cpus_per_node to return the number of available CPUs in the distributed environment
run_get_available_memory_per_node: run get_available_memory_per_node to return the amount of available memory in MB per node
run_get_available_gpus_per_node: run get_available_gpus_per_node to return the number of available GPUs on the current node
run_get_node_rank: run get_node_rank to return the rank of the current node in the distributed environment
run_get_distributed_environment: run get_distributed_environment to determine whether the environment is SLURM, RAY, or LOCAL
